name: featured5-grid
title: Featured5 Grid
description: A six-column highlights grid on near-black, laid out 4+2 then 2+4 across two rows. Cards use 48px radii, a hairline border and a top-to-bottom translucent wash. One card renders a layered concentric-arc mark built entirely in SVG — a blurred glow pass, a hairline pass, a mid-weight body and a white radial highlight, all sharing the same four arc paths. Another holds a working command palette whose rows highlight on hover, click, and arrow-key navigation, wired up with listbox semantics. The entrance lands each empty card frame first, then settles its contents in: the keyboard is set down onto the surface, the marks bloom out of a blur, and the palette results cascade in one row at a time. Collapses to a horizontal scroller below 991px.
